wotc.title: Wizards of the Coast announcement
wotc.note: Primary source. Linked per announcement where the chart cites one, and for 2025 onward.

scryfall.title: Scryfall
scryfall.note: Card identity, original printing, and the live list the replay is checked against.

categories.name: Ante
categories.rule: Cards that reference playing for ante are banned.

categories.name: Conspiracy
categories.rule: Cards with the card type Conspiracy are banned.

categories.name: Offensive content
categories.rule: Cards whose art, text or name is racially or culturally offensive are banned.

categories.name: Stickers and Attractions
categories.rule: Cards that bring stickers or Attractions into play are banned.

pool_exclusions.name: Collectors' and International Edition
pool_exclusions.note: Square-bordered gift-set reprints; never tournament legal. Every card in them is a reprint of a card that was legal from Limited Edition, so excluding them changes no card's legality.

pool_exclusions.name: Silver-bordered and acorn
pool_exclusions.note: Unglued onward. Never tournament legal in any format.

pool_exclusions.name: Digital-only
pool_exclusions.note: Astral Cards onward, through Magic Online and Arena/Alchemy. No paper printing, so never legal in paper Vintage.
